.engramdb/memories/tax-uses-round-half-even_01a0f7cb-38ba-7c01-b969-702b18f5059c.md:15:Tax amounts are rounded with banker's rounding (`decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), as decided with the finance team in March 2026. Do not use ROUND_HALF_UP.

Tax uses banker's rounding, `decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. This comes from a recorded decision made with the finance team in March 2026, and the note says not to use `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

The code doesn't implement it yet. `tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py` just raises `NotImplementedError`, and nothing in the repo references a rounding mode. Whoever implements it should quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
